meta.title: Privacy policy — Mario Álvarez
meta.description: What data marioalvarez.me processes, why, on what legal basis, for how long, and how to exercise your rights.
meta.heading: Privacy policy

bloques.texto: Given the size and type of activity, appointing a data protection officer is not required, so there isn't one: write to me directly.

secciones.titulo: 2. What data I process, why, and on what basis

filas: Usage analytics, only if you accept analytics cookies

A random pseudonymous identifier (visitante_id cookie), the sections and projects you view and the time spent on each, clicks on links and buttons, language, device type (mobile or desktop), approximate country and the page of the website where each event happens.
Your consent (art. 6.1.a GDPR and art. 22.2 LSSI-CE).
12 months; after that each event is deleted automatically.
Record of consents

The pseudonymous identifier, what you accepted, rejected or withdrew, the version of each document, date and time, page, language, source (banner, settings or form), browser (user agent) and approximate country; in the form, also the reference code in your email.
Complying with the obligation to be able to demonstrate consent (arts. 6.1.c and 7.1 GDPR).
3 years from each record (the maximum limitation period for infringements under Spanish data protection law); then deleted automatically.
Replying to your enquiry by email or phone
Whatever data you choose to send me: usually your name, your email or phone and the content of the message.
Taking pre-contractual steps at your request (art. 6.1.b GDPR) or my legitimate interest in replying (art. 6.1.f).
While the conversation lasts and up to 1 year afterwards, unless we end up working together.
Managing a hired service
Identification, contact and billing data.
Performance of the contract (art. 6.1.b GDPR) and tax and accounting obligations (art. 6.1.c).
As long as tax and commercial law require (generally 4 to 6 years).
Remembering whether you prefer the light or dark theme
The "tema" preference, stored only in your browser (local storage). It never reaches me.
A feature you request by pressing the button (exempt from consent under art. 22.2 LSSI-CE).
Until you delete it from your browser.

secciones.titulo: 3. What I don't ask for or collect

bloques.texto: I only process what is essential for each purpose. Specifically:

items: The contact form does not ask for your name, email or phone: it opens your email app and you decide what to send me.
I do not store your IP address, neither in the analytics nor in the record of consents.
I do not use browser fingerprinting, Google Analytics, advertising pixels or third-party cookies.
Typefaces and images are served from this same website: when you visit it, your browser does not connect to Google Fonts, GitHub or other external services.

bloques.texto: I do not sell or share your data with anyone, except where required by law. For the website to work and to reply to you I use these providers:

items: Cloudflare, Inc.: hosts the website and the database (Cloudflare Pages and D1) and acts as a processor. To serve the website it processes technical connection data, such as your IP, which I have no access to. Its policy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
Microsoft Corporation (Outlook.com): the email service where I receive and answer emails; it handles those messages under its own policy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-gb/privacystatement

bloques.texto: Cloudflare and Microsoft may process data in the United States. Both participate in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (European Commission adequacy decision of 10 July 2023) and also offer the standard contractual clauses approved by the Commission.

You can ask me at any time to access your data, rectify it, erase it, object to its processing, restrict it or receive it to take elsewhere (portability), and to withdraw your consent without affecting what was processed before. Write to me at {email}; I will reply within one month at most.

You can delete your analytics data yourself, instantly, with the "Delete my data" button in the cookie settings. The record of consents is kept even if you withdraw consent, because its purpose is precisely to prove when you gave it and when you withdrew it.
If you believe I have not handled your rights properly, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency: https://www.aepd.es
The website is not aimed at children under 14. If you are under 14, please do not send me personal data without your parents' or guardians' permission (art. 7 of Spanish Organic Law 3/2018).
Data travels encrypted (HTTPS) and is stored in a database that can only be accessed from the private panel, protected by username and password.
If something relevant changes, I will update this page and its version date. If the change affects cookies, you will be asked again.
